title: Picco display timings
description: docs/device/picco-timings.json: measured refresh times of the display profiles on the owner's Picco, written after the device session from its benchmark results (plan section 10). The simulator build (scripts/gen_display_timings.py) compiles the medians into the simulator's timing model (lib/DisplayProfileCore/README.md, 'Timing model'). scripts/display_timings.py checks a file against this schema AND these further rules: integers only (no fractions, NaN or Infinity), no duplicate members, p95 >= median and max >= p95 where given, and a file marked "example": true is refused. Every time is in milliseconds.

example.description: True only in docs/device/picco-timings.example.json. The build refuses a timings file that has it set.

panel.description: The panel the numbers were measured on, as the firmware logs it at boot ([EPD] Picco panel ...). XteinkX4 is allowed only in the example, which carries the X4 figures of plan section 2.

source.description: Where the numbers come from: the results files and serial log of the device session, or for the example the measurement it quotes.

profiles.description: Per display profile id (lib/DisplayProfileCore/DisplayProfiles.h). Stock is required; a profile left out keeps the simulator's built-in update time and the stock clear time from this file. An unknown id is an error, so a typo cannot silently leave a profile on its default.

wordUpdateMs.description: Word-band update time over the benchmark's 100 updates. The simulator models each update as the median.

clearMs.description: Clearing refresh time over the benchmark's 5 refreshes. The simulator models each clear as the median.
